title: Immersive Salon Website with AI
skills: Website Design, Graphic Design, User Interface / IA, HTML, UI / User Interface, Web Development, AI Chatbot, AI Integration
description:
I’m rebuilding my hair salon’s entire online presence from the ground up and need a developer–designer hybrid who can take the project from blank canvas to polished launch. The finished site must feel sleek and immersive, loading quickly on desktop and mobile while showcasing services, stylists, and gallery shots in a visually engaging way.

Core feature set  
• An AI-powered assistant dedicated to booking or changing appointments in real time.  
• Full self-service scheduling so visitors can book, reschedule, or cancel appointments on the site without staff intervention.  
• Dual notifications: every confirmed booking must trigger both an email and SMS message to the client.  

Scope of work  
1. UX/UI design: wireframes, mood boards, high-fidelity mock-ups, and smooth micro-interactions that match modern beauty-industry aesthetics.  
2. Front- and back-end development: responsive layout, clean code, and a lightweight CMS so I can update services, prices, and stylist availability myself.  
3. AI integration: connect the site to a conversational model (Dialogflow, GPT, or comparable) and train it on my menu, pricing, and scheduling rules.  
4. Calendar engine: real-time availability management, buffer times, stylist selection logic, and secure storage of customer data compliant with GDPR/CCPA.  
5. Notifications pipeline: email (SMTP or transactional service) and SMS (Twilio or equivalent) for instant confirmations and reminders.  
6. Testing & launch: cross-browser QA, speed

title: Automated Index Futures Arbitrage Bot
skills: C Programming, Java, Python, C# Programming, Software Architecture, C++ Programming, API Development, Algorithmic Trading
description:
I want a fully-automated system that spots and captures price differences in the same Indian index futures quoted simultaneously on NSE and BSE, then places and manages the trades for me without manual intervention. The engine must watch every index future both exchanges list—NIFTY variants, SENSEX, sectoral contracts, anything that appears—and react in real time whenever a profitable spread opens.

Here is the workflow I have in mind: the program streams live market data from both exchanges, calculates the theoretical hedge ratio for each matched contract, and, the moment the spread exceeds my configurable threshold (accounting for brokerage, taxes, and slippage), it sends simultaneous orders to flatten the mis-pricing. Built-in safeguards should cancel or unwind positions if prices converge too slowly, liquidity dries up, or available margin is breached. A concise dashboard summarising open spreads, realised P&L, and exchange connectivity status is all the interface I need; the logic itself must run headless so it can live on a VPS.

I already have broker APIs that support NSE and BSE; plug-and-play compatibility—or a clear adapter layer—is essential. Please code in a mainstream language suited to low-latency market work (Python, C++, or Java are all fine) and document every parameter so I can fine-tune thresholds and risk limits later. On delivery I’ll test it on a paper account first; once it meets the profitability and stability thresholds we’ll migrate to live trading.
